cards.ex: She's really into photography these days; she takes pictures all the time.
cards.exUz: U shu kunlarda fotografiyaga juda qiziqib qoldi; u doimo suratga tushadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga qattiq qiziqish, unga mehr qo'yish.

cards.ex: I can't stand people who talk loudly on their phones in public.
cards.exUz: Men jamoat joylarida telefon orqali baland ovozda gapiradigan odamlarni yoqtirmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani mutlaqo yoqtirmaslik, toqat qilolmaslik.

cards.ex: These days, everyone seems to be working from home.
cards.exUz: Shu kunlarda, hamma uydan ishlayotganga o'xshaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi vaqtda, so'nggi paytlarda sodir bo'layotgan narsalar.

cards.ex: I'm working on a new project at the moment, so I'm quite busy.
cards.exUz: Men hozirda yangi loyiha ustida ishlayapman, shuning uchun juda bandman.
cards.uzDef: Ayni paytda, hozirgi vaqtda sodir bo'layotgan holat.

cards.ex: Are you going to the party? It depends on whether I finish my work.
cards.exUz: Siz ziyofatga borasizmi? Bu ishimni tugatishimga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Bunga bog'liq, vaziyatga qarab o'zgaradi.

cards.ex: The website keeps crashing. I wonder what's wrong.
cards.exUz: Veb-sayt ishdan chiqaveradi. Nima bo'layotgan ekan, deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: Takrorlanishda davom etayotgan voqea yoki holat.

cards.ex: It's getting colder outside; I think it's going to snow.
cards.exUz: Tashqarida havo sovuqlashyapti; o'ylashimcha, qor yog'adi.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarish jarayonida bo'lish, asta-sekin rivojlanish.

cards.ex: I often come across interesting articles when I'm browsing the internet.
cards.exUz: Men internetda sayr qilganimda ko'pincha qiziqarli maqolalarga duch kelaman.
cards.uzDef: Tasodifan topib qolish yoki uchratish.

cards.ex: I'm really looking forward to my vacation next month.
cards.exUz: Men keyingi oy bo'ladigan ta'tilimni juda ham kutyapman.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda ro'y beradigan narsadan xursand bo'lish, intiqlik bilan kutish.

cards.ex: More and more people are using electric cars these days.
cards.exUz: Shu kunlarda tobora ko'proq odamlar elektromobillardan foydalanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tobora ko'proq, doimiy ravishda o'sib boruvchi miqdor.

cards.ex: As a rule, I don't eat fast food, but sometimes I make exceptions.
cards.exUz: Qoida sifatida, men tez ovqat yemayman, lekin ba'zida istisno qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Odatda, ko'p hollarda sodir bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: I was about to leave when the phone rang.
cards.exUz: Men ketmoqchi bo'lganimda telefon jiringladi.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada sodir bo'lishi kutilayotgan voqea.

cards.ex: For now, I'm living with my parents, but I plan to move out soon.
cards.exUz: Hozircha men ota-onam bilan yashayman, lekin yaqinda alohida chiqmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtinchalik, hozirgi vaqtda, lekin kelajakda o'zgarishi mumkin.

cards.ex: He tends to arrive late for meetings, which is quite annoying.
cards.exUz: U odatda yig'ilishlarga kech keladi, bu juda asabiylashadi.
cards.uzDef: Odatda shunday bo'lishga moyil, xususiyatga ega.

cards.ex: At this stage, we're still gathering information before making a decision.
cards.exUz: Bu bosqichda, biz qaror qabul qilishdan oldin hali ham ma'lumot to'playapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi paytda, ushbu vaziyatda.

cards.ex: First thing I do in the morning is make a cup of coffee.
cards.exUz: Men ertalab birinchi qiladigan ishim - bir chashka qahva tayyorlash.
cards.uzDef: Eng birinchi qiladigan ish, erta tongda.

cards.ex: On the whole, I enjoy living in this city, despite the traffic.
cards.exUz: Umuman olganda, men bu shaharda yashashdan zavqlanaman, transport tirbandligiga qaramay.
cards.uzDef: Umuman, asosan, ko'p hollarda.

cards.ex: What are you up to tonight? Do you want to hang out?
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun nima qilmoqchisan? Birga vaqt o'tkazishni xohlaysizmi?
cards.uzDef: Biron bir ish bilan mashg'ul bo'lish, nima bilan shug'ullanayotganini so'rash.

cards.ex: We should definitely keep in touch after you move to another city.
cards.exUz: Siz boshqa shaharga ko'chib o'tganingizdan keyin albatta aloqada bo'lishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Do'stona aloqalarni saqlab qolish, doimiy ravishda xabar olishib turish.

cards.ex: My new roommates and I are getting along really well so far.
cards.exUz: Mening yangi xonadoshlarim va men hozircha juda yaxshi kelishyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: O'zaro yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish, do'stona bo'lish.

cards.ex: It turns out I was wrong about the meeting time; it's actually tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ma'lum bo'lishicha, men yig'ilish vaqti haqida yanglishgan ekanman; u aslida ertaga ekan.
cards.uzDef: Natijada shunday bo'lib chiqdi, aniqlanishicha.

cards.ex: I ran into an old friend at the grocery store yesterday.
cards.exUz: Men kecha oziq-ovqat do'konida eski do'stimni uchratib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Tasodifan kimnidir yoki nimanidir uchratib qolish.

cards.ex: I'm feeling a bit tired, so I'm going to take it easy this weekend.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni biroz charchaganday his qilyapman, shuning uchun bu dam olish kunlari dam olaman.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish, stressdan uzoq bo'lish, o'zini ehtiyot qilish.

cards.ex: I try to work out at the gym three times a week.
cards.exUz: Men haftada uch marta sport zalida mashq qilishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Sport bilan shug'ullanish, jismoniy mashqlar bajarish.

cards.ex: Let's hang out this weekend; we could go to the movies.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu dam olish kunlari birga vaqt o'tkazamiz; biz kinoga borishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlar bilan vaqtni birga o'tkazish, dam olish.

cards.ex: The hike was difficult, but the view from the top was definitely worth it.
cards.exUz: Piyoda yurish qiyin edi, lekin tepadan ko'rinish albatta bunga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Qilingan harakatga yoki sarflangan mablag'ga arziydi.

cards.ex: She's always on the phone with her friends.
cards.exUz: U doimo do'stlari bilan telefonda gaplashadi.
cards.uzDef: Telefon orqali gaplashish, telefon qo'ng'irog'ida bo'lish.

cards.ex: We should get together for coffee sometime soon.
cards.exUz: Tez orada qahva ichish uchun yig'ilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda vaqt o'tkazish uchun yig'ilish, uchrashish.

cards.ex: Things are going well at work, I just got a promotion.
cards.exUz: Ishda ishlar yaxshi ketyapti, men yaqinda lavozimimni oshirdim.
cards.uzDef: Ishlar qanday ketayotganligi, vaziyatning rivojlanishi.

cards.ex: I'm still getting used to living in a big city.
cards.exUz: Men hali ham katta shaharda yashashga ko'nikyapman.
cards.uzDef: Yangi sharoitga yoki odatga asta-sekin ko'nikish.
